khm.text: Kaldheim is a plane of ten realms where the Skoti pantheon has supplanted the Einir gods, who became the plane's elves, and the Skoti prohibited Koma from entering any realm.

The plane is thrown into crisis when Tibalt, poisoned by the Horrible Beast and forced to cause a distraction, disguises himself as Valki and visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.

Tibalt creates a Doomskar, and thousands of demons led by Varragoth stream through a rift to attack another realm, while Alrund instructs Kaya, Tyvar and the clan leaders that the Sword must be given to Halvar to end it.
Kaya ends the Doomskar by cutting Varragoth's throat with one of Tyvar's axes, and Tyvar resolves to walk the Multiverse.

fdn.text: Kaldheim appears in Foundations as a plane where valkyries and giants live, and Helle takes her place among the honored host after learning one thousand tales.
